newsitem.title: USA: United Cities Gas Co granted rate increase.
newsitem.headline: United Cities Gas Co granted rate increase.

text.p: United Cities Gas Co said on Monday that the Virginia State Corporate Commission had granted the company a rate increase amounting to $102,838 in annual revenues.

An overall rate increase of less than one percent was granted for roughly 18,000 current regulated customers, the company said in a statement, which provides United Cities with a 10 percent return on rate base and an 11 percent return on common equity.
United Cities' last rate increase in Virginia was granted in 1989. Since that time, rate reductions were implemented in 1991 and 1994, the company said.
United Cities Gas Co distributes natural and propane gas to 350,000 customers in 10 states.
